end.summary:
Copied shapes on a dot or square grid by counting units along sides.
Initially counted dots instead of gaps once; corrected this later by identifying four gaps between five dots.
Identified the starting dot when tracing a closed shape.
Recognised moved or turned shapes as the same size and shape in two attempts.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Myra practised copying shapes on dot and square grids by counting the gaps between dots and checking the starting point. They also practised recognising a shape after it is moved or turned; the dot-versus-gap mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. At home, draw short lines on dot paper and ask Myra to count the gaps, not the dots, then copy the shape.
